heading: Today
text: Becoming mostly sunny south, mixing with afternoon clouds. Some breaks of morning sun north, more afternoon clouds, with a few localized showers over the higher terrain.  Breezy and cooler.  Highs in the 50s north, low 60s south, steady or falling this afternoon.  Winds becoming west to northwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: A stray evening shower northeast.  Periods of clouds retreating to the mountains, becoming mostly clear in southern and western valleys.  Lows in the upper 20s to mid 30s.  Winds northwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph.

heading: Saturday
text: Morning clouds in the mountains giving way to increasing sun.  Mostly sunny in western and southern valleys.  Cool.  Highs in the 40s to near 50 north, in the low to mid 50s south.  Winds northwest near 10 mph, gusting to 25 mph east of the Green Mountains, diminishing in the afternoon.

heading: Halloween
text: Morning clouds in the mountains giving way to increasing sun.  Mostly sunny in western and southern valleys.  Cool.  Highs in the 40s to near 50 north, in the low to mid 50s south.  Winds northwest near 10 mph, gusting to 25 mph east of the Green Mountains, diminishing in the afternoon.
